changeSet.author: Amila
changeSet.comment:
Production environment - No test data inserted All users should be created through the application's registration endpoint or through an admin portal in a production environment.
IMPORTANT SECURITY NOTES: 1. Never hardcode user passwords in migration scripts for production 2. Always use secure password hashing (BCrypt with appropriate strength) 3. Consider implementing user creation through an initialization script or admin UI 4. Implement proper audit logging for user creation and modifications
